Board                                      
  h/l j/k      column, card                
  gg/G         first/last card             
  ctrl+d/u     half page down/up           
  1-5          column by number            
  enter        details                     
  e            edit tasks                  
  s            start the agent             
  /            filter by name              
  n/N          next/previous match         
  esc          clear the filter, else close
  r            reload                      
  ?            this help                   
  q            close                       
                                           
Filter prompt                              
  enter/esc    keep/clear the filter       
  backspace    delete, close when empty
